text:
Orthodontic Treatment Review – About Tooth Dental Clinic Siam

I underwent Damon braces treatment with Dr. Gift at About Tooth Dental Clinic. It took about 2 years and I can honestly say I'm very happy with the results.

I have to say, I'm terrified of dentists, but Dr. Gift made my fear disappear. She's lovely, patient, explains things in detail, and is very gentle. Every step felt very comfortable.
From being afraid and anxious, now I come to the clinic without stress, thanks to Dr. Gift.

During my treatment, Dr. Gift provided excellent continuous care. She was straightforward, didn't rush me, didn't try to sell me anything unnecessary, and I saw clear changes in my teeth steadily. Now, my braces are complete, I can smile confidently, and the results are beautiful.

All the staff are also lovely, providing excellent and friendly service. They take great care of you every time you visit. The clinic is clean and has a great atmosphere.

If you're looking for orthodontic treatment or are afraid of dentists like me,
I highly recommend About Tooth Dental Clinic Siam.
Especially Dr. Gift; I was very impressed! 😊
